title: A2 Level Final Exam
description: Test your knowledge of Present Perfect vs Past Simple, Present Perfect Continuous, Past Perfect, Future Continuous, Future Perfect, Conditionals Type 2/3, Reported Speech, Passive all tenses, Relative clauses, Gerunds vs Infinitives, Used to vs Be used to

exercises.instruction: Choose Past Simple or Present Perfect.

items.sentence: I ___ (see) that movie yesterday.
I ___ (see) that movie. (experience)

exercises.instruction: Fill in the present perfect continuous form.

items.sentence: I ___ (work) here for five years.
It ___ (rain) since morning.

exercises.instruction: Fill in the past perfect form.

items.sentence: The film ___ (already start) when we arrived.
I realized that I ___ (forget) my keys.

exercises.instruction: Fill in the future continuous or future perfect.

items.sentence: This time tomorrow, I ___ (fly) to Paris.
By next year, I ___ (finish) my degree.

exercises.instruction: Fill in the correct forms (second/third conditional).

items.sentence: If I ___ (have) a million dollars, I ___ (travel) around the world.
If you ___ (call) me, I ___ (help) you.

exercises.instruction: Change to reported speech (possible variants: with or without 'that').

items.sentence: He said, 'I am tired.' → He said ___
She asked, 'Where did you buy that dress?' → She asked ___
items.correct: where I had bought that dress

items.sentence: They are building a new hotel. → A new hotel ___
They will announce the results tomorrow. → The results ___

exercises.instruction: Fill in who, which, that, or where.

items.sentence: The woman ___ lives next door is a doctor.
This is the house ___ I grew up.

exercises.instruction: Fill in the gerund or infinitive.

items.sentence: I remember ___ (lock) the door. (I have a memory)
I remembered ___ (lock) the door. (I didn't forget)

exercises.instruction: Fill in used to or be used to.

items.sentence: I ___ play the piano when I was a child.
I ___ getting up early. (accustomed)

items.target: I have been working here for five years.

items.source: Если бы у меня была машина, я бы ездил на работу.
items.target: If I had a car, I would drive to work.
He said that he was tired.
